examples.title: Absinthe, American Service
examples.modern:
Ingredients:
- 4 dashes Gum Syrup (simple syrup)
- 1 oz Absinthe (or pastis if unavailable)

Method:
1. Mixing glass 3/4 full crushed ice.
2. Shake until outside of shaker is well frosted; strain into large
3. Champagne glass and serve.

examples.title: Absinthe Cocktail
examples.modern:
Ingredients:
- 3/4 oz Water
- 3/4 oz Absinthe (or pastis if unavailable)
- 2 dashes Angostura (Angostura bitters) Bitters
- 1 tsp Benedictine (Benedictine)

Method:
1. Mixing glass 3/4 full crushed ice.
2. Stir; strain into Cocktail glass and serve.

examples.title: Absinthe Frappe
examples.modern:
Ingredients:
- 1 tsp Benedictine (Benedictine)
- 1 oz Absinthe (or pastis if unavailable)

Method:
1. Fill mixing glass full of crushed ice.
2. Shake until outside of Shaker has frosty appearance; strain into
3. six-ounce highball glass and serve.

examples.title: Brandy Crusta
